item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02625","case1_error":"Correct setup is followed by unsupported 19; the required difference is 9.","case2_error":"Counts each win as one point instead of the stipulated two points.","reason":"The first supplies an incorrect final number after correct formulas; the second uses an incorrect scoring relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02626","case1_error":"Evaluates Anna's correctly specified 14 × 60 total as 252 instead of 840.","case2_error":"Evaluates $14 divided by the rate $2 per three pieces as two pieces instead of 21.","reason":"Both incorrectly evaluate a correctly specified expression for the relevant quantity.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02627","case1_error":"Treats Frank's sold third, 12 apples, as his remaining apples instead of subtracting it from 36.","case2_error":"Subtracts signed velocities instead of comparing speed magnitudes, producing 800 instead of 40.","reason":"The first confuses the removed portion with the remainder; the second confuses velocity difference with speed difference.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02628","case1_error":"Subtracts shared movies only once, although each shared movie has two excess counts; the distinct total is 30.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported 52 after correctly setting up 8 × 7 minus 2, which yields 54.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect overlap correction; the second supplies an incorrect final number after correct formulas.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02629","case1_error":"Uses the first day's combined 50 flowers as its tulip count, incorrectly charging an additional 20 tulips.","case2_error":"Subtracts restaurant apples twice, miscalculates that subtraction, introduces unsupported 56 bags, and incorrectly evaluates 408 ÷ 56.","reason":"The first substitutes a combined total for a category count; the second duplicates a deduction and adds independent numerical and unsupported-count errors.","judgment":"different"}]}
